beforeImage.name: New Leaf Energy
beforeImage.description: New Leaf Energy develops utility-scale, commercial, and community solar and storage projects for utilities, corporate offtakers, and community energy programs in the United States. The company operates as a development platform that originates sites, secures permits and interconnection, advances offtake arrangements, and manages projects through financing and construction handoff. Its model is development-led and contracted rather than merchant, with value tied to a pipeline of permitted and construction-ready projects across multiple power markets. ECP and company materials describe a development portfolio of approximately 15 gigawatts of solar and 7 gigawatts of storage, which provides a large national scale indicator for the platform. The business was formed in July 2022 through the spin-off of Borrego's development business backed by ECP, and it now operates as a standalone renewables developer under that ownership.

afterImage.name: New Leaf Energy
afterImage.description: New Leaf Energy, Inc. is a U.S. solar and energy-storage development platform formed in 2022 through the carve-out of Borrego's development business. It originates and advances commercial, community and utility-scale projects through siting, interconnection, permitting, offtake and construction-ready handoff. ECP completed its acquisition on July 27, 2022 and continues to list New Leaf as current; its exact current stake, fund and holding vehicle are not publicly disclosed. Walsin Lihwa's controlling block was sold in the 2022 transaction, and Walsin America separately sold back its entire 88,729-share block to New Leaf, leaving Walsin with no current interest. Borrego's retained EPC/O&M/Anza businesses and individual project companies or portfolios remain outside the canonical platform. ECP reports a pipeline of approximately 15 GW of solar and 7 GW of storage, with about 1 GW of photovoltaic projects and 450 MWh of battery projects sold. No later platform sale, sponsor exit or signed pending ownership transfer was identified through August 29, 2026.
